requirement: Load data/active_file_manifest.json before loading Year Zero bundles.
notes: Only files listed as active Year Zero bundles may be used.

requirement: Validate bundle columns against consolidated_bundle_schema.csv and csv_schema_registry.csv before parsing payload_json.
notes: Reject missing columns, invalid category enums, malformed JSON, and duplicate bundle_file+source_table+source_row composite keys.

requirement: Parse payload_json into typed domain records only after bundle-level validation passes.
notes: Do not let gameplay systems read raw payload_json ad hoc.

requirement: Filter by record_category before any runtime use.
notes: Never feed algorithm/example/research_basis/debug_schema rows into generation logic.

requirement: Expose selectors by domain and source_table.
notes: Avoid hardcoding source filenames throughout gameplay systems.

requirement: Year Zero bundles are fresh-save bootstrap data only. Annual systems use normal active_runtime_csvs after bootstrap.
notes: Do not mix annual star_distribution or development curves into Year Zero unless an explicit bridge rule calls for it.

requirement: Use deterministic RNG streams for every Year Zero subsystem.
notes: Same seed must create same universe.

requirement: Emit debug records explaining selected source_table, category, seed stream, and outcome.
notes: Debug outputs should make bootstrap choices auditable.

requirement: Reject duplicate composite keys using bundle_file + source_table + source_row. Do not reject repeated bare row_key values across source tables.
notes: row_key values are not globally unique inside a consolidated bundle; they are source-table scoped.
